strings.displayEventSummary: /// <summary>Raised when a display or impulse monitor publishes a value.</summary>
strings.monitorEventSummary: /// <summary>Raised when a Runtime Display monitor changes.</summary>
strings.disposedWorldQueue: // A disposed/transitioning world cannot retain a runnable queue.
strings.worldDrainOrder:
// Drain non-userspace Worlds first: they may enqueue follow-up work
        // into Userspace, so the Userspace barrier must run last.
strings.fifoBarrier:
// All queued delegates crossed a FIFO barrier; wait once more for
        // an entry that began immediately before its barrier.
strings.faultedTaskDrain:
// A finished faulted task is still fully drained. Its graph
                // error was already reported at the execution boundary.
strings.worldMutationContext:
// Updates is only a wait primitive. World.RunSynchronously
                    // is what grants the valid world mutation context.
strings.executionIsolation:
// Each execution entry owns transient outputs; never inherit
            // values from another entry.
strings.executionKernel:
// Each root event owns a FIFO execution frame. Continuations are drained
    // iteratively, and the global lock serializes independent roots.
strings.loggingBoundary: // Logging must never escape back into Resonite's host callback.
strings.monitorWorldTransition: // A temporary world transition must not stop the monitor pump.
strings.collectibleDisplayBoundary:
// The external display bridge may cache values. Never publish objects
        // whose runtime Type belongs to the collectible generated DLL.
strings.immutableDisplaySnapshot:
// Snapshot mutable values before publication so later mutations
            // cannot change already-published display text.
strings.patchRegistration: // Generated registration marker for the matching custom RML loader.
strings.advancedSource: Advanced C# is exported verbatim and must compile against the target Resonite/RML assemblies.
